items.detail: Every page was tested in Chromium at 320–1920px, light and dark, with no overflow or errors, and the code avoids Safari-unsafe features. Firefox, Safari and Samsung Internet weren't available here, so give it one pass on an iPhone and a Mac before launch.

items.detail: GitHub Pages on this account is public: anyone with the link can open the drafts. They carry a Draft banner and are hidden from search engines. Going private needs GitHub Enterprise or a host with access control, such as Cloudflare Access.
